name: Novosibirsk
scopeLimits: The ranked WUP point is a population-weighted Novosibirsk locator, not a parcel identity. The city’s Rosreestr notices identify the NSPD public cadastral map and EGRN Land Parcels layer for Novosibirsk. The official map host timed out in web and direct shell requests, so its live schema and any geometry response were not verified. No parcel lookup or cadastral-number query was submitted.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: Novosibirsk municipal notices prepared with the regional Rosreestr/Roskadastr offices direct citizens to the NSPD Public Cadastral Map and its EGRN Land Parcels layer for information on local land parcels. Public map use is described as available to anyone, without owner names.
technicalBlocker: The official NSPD map URL timed out in both the web reader and an ordinary anonymous HTTPS GET. No layer metadata, service JS, or full geometry response could be inspected.
remainingUncertainty: Whether the current NSPD viewer exposes a public vector or only rendered parcel graphics from this environment; the WUP point’s parcel coverage remains unverified.
nextStep: Retry ordinary access to the official NSPD map when the host responds, then inspect a public layer schema before a safe bounded geometry-only query.
